assignments_has_endpoint.name: assignments_has_endpoint
assignments_has_endpoint.value: "assignments"."source_envelope_id" IS NOT NULL OR "assignments"."destination_envelope_id" IS NOT NULL

assignments_distinct_endpoints.name: assignments_distinct_endpoints
assignments_distinct_endpoints.value: "assignments"."source_envelope_id" IS NULL OR "assignments"."destination_envelope_id" IS NULL OR "assignments"."source_envelope_id" <> "assignments"."destination_envelope_id"

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."account_id" <> "transactions"."to_account_id")
        OR ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NULL)
